summary: First iteration end-to-end testing for TOP ONE. Wrote pytest suite (22 tests) covering all public + user + admin backend endpoints, and drove full mobile UI via Playwright (390x844): onboarding → home → subscription → payment → profile → 5-tap admin gate → admin login → admin dashboard. Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL backend bug (offset-naive vs offset-aware datetime comparison in _expire_subscription_if_needed causing GET /api/subscriptions/me and /api/users/me to 500 whenever the user had an active sub). After fix, 22/22 backend tests pass and full frontend flow works end-to-end. UI: onboarding testIDs (onboarding-next-1, onboarding-top-one-id, onboarding-copy-id, onboarding-finish), home-top-one-id, quick-subscribe, tab-games/results/notifications/profile, profile-version all present and functional. Subscription screen shows Base ₹299 (3 Open + 6 Jodi) and Pro ₹599 (1 Open + 2 Jodi + 2 Pane). Payment screen shows UPI 6303514885@ibl + QR + UTR form. 5-tap admin gate + admin login (bipinkumar202425@gmail.com / Ammu@0715 / 071525) works and lands on admin dashboard.

critical.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes in _expire_subscription_if_needed (server.py:523). MongoDB returns datetime tz-naive by default while _now() is tz-aware. Any user with an active subscription got a 500. FIXED by initialising AsyncIOMotorClient with tz_aware=True, tzinfo=timezone.utc (server.py:51).

issues: 'MEMBER ID' small caps label on the gold ID card is nearly invisible against the gold texture background (very low contrast). Consider a semi-transparent dark chip behind the label or a darker overlay on the gold texture.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Cosmetic on web preview only, but consider passing useNativeDriver: false for web or gating animations. Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Migrate any pointerEvents props into style. Reference: react-native-web deprecation.

rca_of_issue: RCA: motor's AsyncIOMotorClient defaults to tz-naive datetimes returned from MongoDB. server.py stored _now() (tz-aware UTC) via insert, but when reading back the sub doc, expires_at came back tz-naive. Line `sub['expires_at'] < _now()` then raised TypeError. Reproduction: init user → submit base payment → admin verify → GET /api/subscriptions/me → 500. Mitigation: pass tz_aware=True, tzinfo=timezone.utc to AsyncIOMotorClient (single-line change on server.py:51). Verified by re-running the full pytest suite (22/22 pass) and the end-to-end payment→verify→subscription flow.
